searchText: <@!689161464829050960> does the `valueSponseeMax` parameter in 3074 break some current mempool invariants? Before 3074 it wasn't for the balance of an external account to decrease unless a transaction emanated from the account, this wouldn't be true after 3074. Do miners rely on this invariant for computing transaction validity when packing transactions? It does, yes. `valueSponseeMax` is probably the first to go if anyone has an issue with it. hmm, shame. Also what's the envisioned purpose of this being a max value?
